description: This Java class defines a ViewModel for managing user accounts within an Android application, specifically for the Nextcloud Notes client. It handles retrieving the current account, listing all accounts, deleting accounts, selecting an account, and counting unsynchronized notes, utilizing Android architecture components and external helpers.

classes.name: ManageAccountsViewModel
classes.description: An Android ViewModel that manages user account operations such as retrieval, deletion, and selection within the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

methods.name: ManageAccountsViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewModel with application context and repository instance.

methods.name: getCurrentAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the current account asynchronously and returns it via callback, handling exceptions if no account is found or none is selected.

methods.name: getAccounts$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of accounts, with distinct changes only.

methods.name: deleteAccount
methods.description: Deletes the specified account asynchronously, and selects an adjacent account or null if none remain.

methods.name: selectAccount
methods.description: Sets the specified account as the current account in the app.

methods.name: countUnsynchronizedNotes
methods.description: Counts the number of unsynchronized notes for a given account asynchronously.
